title: delegated-ssh-ca-vault-integration-rotation-automation
author: Priya Nandakumar
description: Motivation: Private deployments require a secure, automated way to rotate SSH signing keys used for ephemeral host certificates and to delegate signing to Vault-managed PKI roles. This PR wires vault PKI roles into the private installer, adds a controller to perform safe timed rotations for the delegated SSH CA, and provides Helm and Terraform surfaces for orchestration and downgrade-safe upgrades. Changes include a Terraform module to create and manage the Vault PKI role and its policies, a Helm issuer and controller deployment for requesting ephemeral SSH CA certs, upgrade/rollback hooks to ensure atomic install and safe rollback, and an optional sealed-secrets-backed bootstrap path for air-gapped clusters. The description below is a single continuous string that documents implementation details, testing, and migration steps. Implementation notes: - Terraform: new module terraform/modules/vault-pki creates a named PKI mount, role with allowed_domains and ttl bounds, and a policy for the installer service account; outputs include role_name and ca_pub_key. - Helm: added pki-issuer template that can use either cert-manager or a lightweight Vault Issuer sidecar; values.yaml exposes vault address, role, and bootstrap sealed secret toggle. - Controller: installer/pkg/rotation/ssh_ca_controller.go implements a leader-electing controller that requests a new SSH CA cert from Vault, atomically rotates the in-cluster secret, primes KV caching for runtime agents, and emits events/metrics. It supports staged rollouts and abort semantics in case of health regressions. - Upgrade hooks: installer/cmd/upgrade/rollback_hooks.go contains pre-upgrade validation (verify Vault connectivity, verify role permissions), a post-upgrade verification step (rotate then validate ephemeral cert issuance), and a rollback path that re-applies the prior CA secret if health checks fail. - Sealed secrets: optional bootstrap recipe that encrypts the initial Vault token/role binding for air-gapped installs; documented in docs/private/ssh-ca-rotation.md. Testing: unit tests for the controller logic and k8s secret swaps are included; integration script scripts/integration/test-vault-pki.sh exercises real Vault under CI staging. Migration notes: existing clusters that manage SSH keys in cluster must follow the migration steps in docs/private/ssh-ca-rotation.md which include a one-time coordinated rotation window and can be automated via the provided example in examples/vpc/ssh-ca-delegation-example.yaml. Related tickets: ENG-4823 (private installer PKI integration), ENG-4981 (rotation automation and rollback safety), SUP-2112 (customer report of SSH cert expiry during upgrade).

review_comments: Evan Schultz: Can we avoid a downtime window by doing a leader-based double-write (new secret + backup) and then flip? Please add e2e to cover this path.
Priya Nandakumar: Responded: implemented staged double-write and atomic swap; added integration test script that simulates agent cert requests against old and new CA during rollout.
Marina Kwon: Request change: add metrics for rotation success/failure and a prometheus scrape annotation on the controller deployment.
Priya Nandakumar: Addressed: added rotation_success_total and rotation_fail_total metrics, and helm chart exposes scrape annotations via values.yaml.
Luca Romano: Note: ensure rollback is safe for clusters with multiple controllers (leader election). Verified logic but suggested clearer logging on abort reasons.
Priya Nandakumar: Done: improved logging for abort paths and added an 'abort_reason' event field; updated runbook with expected error messages.
CI: Initial integration job failed due to missing VAULT_ADDR in CI env; fixed by adding a staging Vault fixture and re-ran.
release_notes: Add automated Vault-backed SSH CA delegation and rotation: new terraform/vault-pki module, helm pki issuer and controller, upgrade/rollback hooks for safe rotations, and optional sealed-secrets bootstrap for air-gapped installs. Includes metrics and docs for operational runbook.
